name: prowl-cli
description: Prowl CLI skill: drive the 448-tool Prowl market-intelligence catalog from the shell with @prowl-ai/cli — no MCP server required.

interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent the Prowl command-line client (@prowl-ai/cli): install and key handling, the free catalog commands, metered tool calls, analyze tiers with hard cost caps, playbooks, JSON output and exit codes. Useful wherever a shell is available and no MCP server is configured.
defaultPrompt: Search the Prowl tool catalog for backlink tools
Run prowl analyze on a competitor domain
